attempted_claim: Let C be an irreducible complex projective plane curve of degree 9, rational (geometric genus 0), whose non-nodal singularities are exactly one ramphoid cusp of analytic type A4 (local equation y^2=x^5, delta-invariant 2, Tjurina number 4) and one ordinary cusp of analytic type A2 (delta-invariant 1, Tjurina number 2) in distinct positions, and whose remaining singularities are exactly 25 ordinary nodes. Impose passage through 23 points in general position in P^2. Using the relative Gromov-Witten degeneration of P^2 along a line H via the multi-root-stack correspondence (total class 9L, contact orders partitioning 9 along H, with a stated 5-fold ramification profile at the A4 point versus 3-fold at the A2 point) with its full degeneration-ledger sum, plus (C*)^2 torus localization evaluations of the contributing relative and orbifold rubber invariants, prove finiteness and transversality under the 23 point conditions and determine with proof the exact finite enumerative number N(9,A4+A2) counting such mixed-cusp curves (each singularity assignment counted once, nodes unordered). A complete answer is a proved nonnegative integer value together with the certified ledger sum and localization contributions yielding it.
